component.name: tmpl
component.summary: tui-inspired music player, based on dmt

description.p: Terminal look, amber on black, cover art as ascii. Plays local files or your own Jellyfin server, with bundled ffmpeg decoders, synced lyrics (lrc and ttml), cue sheets, replay gain and listening stats.
Developed by ivnls, based on dmt by Jyotiraditya Panda (https://github.com/imjyotiraditya/dmt).
